stories.title: Here are the 30,000 songs Sony is suing Udio’s AI music generator over
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Sony Music is suing the AI music generator Udio over copyright infringement.
The lawsuit claims Udio infringed on over 30,000 songs, including tracks by Elvis Presley, Beyoncé, and Harry Styles.
This case highlights major legal challenges surrounding AI training data and intellectual property in the music industry.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The speed improvement is attributed to the use of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Performance gains reach up to 90% faster when running with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements translate to higher quality model responses.
The updates also result in faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new AI model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released as an open-source framework for building personal AI agents.
A key feature is its local-first architecture, allowing AI to run entirely on user hardware.
It integrates native support for Ollama, simplifying the deployment of local LLMs.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance gains.
This integration specifically targets and optimizes performance on Apple Silicon hardware.
The feature is currently available in a preview release.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a new personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging apps with local AI coding agents.
The core feature emphasizes running all AI processes entirely on the user's own device for privacy.

stories.title: Ford’s $30,000 electric truck: all the news about the company’s big EV re-do
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Ford is pivoting its electric vehicle strategy after the initial F-150 Lightning did not meet market expectations.
The automaker is developing a new Universal Electric Vehicle Platform for future models.
The next offering from this new platform is slated to be a $30,000 electric truck.

stories.title: AliExpress hit with record $625M fine after failing to make EU-ordered fixes
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: AliExpress received a record $625 million fine from EU regulators.
The fine stems from the retailer's failure to implement required fixes under the Digital Services Act (DSA).
The incident highlights increasing regulatory scrutiny and enforcement power within the EU's digital market.

stories.title: Pay up or not? Ransomware surge has victims facing tough choices.
stories.author: Hannah Murphy, Financial Times
bullet_points: Ransomware attacks are increasing in sophistication, posing significant risks to victims.
Governments are actively considering legislation to prohibit the payment of ransoms.
The situation forces organizations and individuals to make difficult decisions regarding threat response.

stories.title: Differentiable Logic Gate Networks for Low-Latency EEG Classification on Edge Devices
stories.author: Camilo E. Valderrama
bullet_points: Proposes Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (Diff-Logic) as a hardware-native alternative to conventional neural networks for EEG classification.
Addresses the latency bottleneck of floating-point arithmetic by compiling models into pure Boolean circuits executable via bitwise CPU operations.
Demonstrated effectiveness across diverse EEG datasets for tasks like dementia detection and emotion recognition on edge devices.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It specifically augments Ollama's MLX engine, improving functionality on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for subagents within Claude Code.
The new feature set includes the capability for web search functionality in Claude Code.
This enhancement expands the capabilities of local LLM orchestration via Ollama.

stories.title: The FCC is planning to retroactively ban disguised DJI gadgets
stories.author: Sean Hollister
bullet_points: The FCC is preparing to use its newly acquired authority to retroactively ban certain gadgets.
The crackdown specifically targets 'DJI front companies' suspected of circumventing regulations.
This action represents the first application of the FCC's power to ban already approved imported devices.

stories.title: SpaceX in your index fund, explained
stories.author: Elizabeth Lopatto
bullet_points: The article discusses the implications of a high-risk, speculative company like SpaceX being included in a broad market index fund (Nasdaq-100).
It contrasts the perceived safety of index funds with the volatility and high valuation of individual, cutting-edge tech companies.
The core topic is the intersection of mainstream investment vehicles and high-growth, high-risk private/speculative tech.

stories.title: LG’s monitors come with an unwanted addition for Windows: McAfee pop-up ads
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: LG monitors are silently installing software via Windows Update when first connected to a PC.
The installation includes the LG Monitor App Installer without user notification or permission prompts.
The installed application reportedly lacks visible user controls, raising potential concerns about unwanted software.

stories.title: Firefighting drones in the works as wildfires plague US nearly year-round
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Drones are being developed and tested as a potential tool for wildfire management.
The technology is being explored in California, with an XPRIZE competition driving innovation.
The focus is on using drones to detect and stop wildfires in their early stages.

stories.title: Judge halts Paramount's $111B purchase of Warner Bros. in win for US states
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: A judge has issued a restraining order against Paramount's proposed $111B acquisition of Warner Bros.
The court determined that the merger is likely to violate existing antitrust laws.
The ruling represents a significant victory for US states challenging large media consolidation.

stories.title: The Space Force is now seeking to buy up to $30 billion in rocket launches
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: The Space Force is being tasked with a significant increase in rocket launch operations.
The procurement goal involves acquiring up to $30 billion worth of launch services.
The initiative is being driven by directives from the Trump administration.

stories.title: Simple Domain Generalization for Strong Pixel-Level Image Tampering Detection in Modern VLMs
stories.author: Zhiqiang Shen
bullet_points: Addresses the growing challenge of detecting pixel-level image tampering in modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) like Gemini and ChatGPT.
Focuses on Domain Generalization to ensure tampering detection models remain robust across different VLM-generated manipulation styles (out-of-distribution shifts).
Aims to develop localization models capable of reliably identifying tampering regardless of the specific VLM used for image generation/editing.

stories.title: GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Efficient Pathology Foundation Models for Whole-Slide and Tumor Microenvironment Analysis
stories.author: Hoifung Poon
bullet_points: Introduces GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash, new efficient foundation models for computational pathology.
Addresses limitations in current pathology models, such as tile-level operation, restrictive licensing, and high computational cost.
Aims to advance cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment selection by leveraging large-scale histopathology data.

stories.title: Learning Adaptive Safety Margins for Visual Navigation
stories.author: Yi Fang
bullet_points: Addresses a critical failure point in robot navigation: the miscalibration of fixed safety margins in cluttered environments.
Proposes a novel 'context-conditioned safety critic' to learn adaptive clearance preferences for path planning.
Focuses on improving trajectory selection reliability when using diffusion-based planners from RGB-D input.

stories.title: TRIM: Reducing AI-Generated CodeSlop via Agent Trajectory Minimization
stories.author: Baishakhi Ray
bullet_points: The paper addresses the issue of 'codeSlop'—AI-generated code being overly verbose compared to human code.
The root cause is identified as the agent's internal search process, which accumulates speculative and abandoned edits.
The proposed solution, TRIM, aims to reduce this code bloat by minimizing the agent's trajectory during code generation.

stories.title: LLMs and Agentic AI Systems for Smart Grids: A Tutorial on Architectures and Applications
stories.author: Yuanyuan Shi
bullet_points: The paper explores the application of LLMs and agentic AI systems to smart grid management.
These systems use agents to orchestrate multi-step workflows for forecasting, optimization, and control by wrapping traditional solvers.
A key challenge identified is the lack of a unified methodology for designing and evaluating these complex, tool-using AI systems.

stories.title: The Many Senses of Visual Similarity: A Text-Prompted Image Perceptual Metric
stories.author: Richard Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces a new perceptual metric for visual similarity that can be conditioned on specific semantic aspects (e.g., shape vs. color).
Addresses a limitation in existing metrics which collapse nuanced visual differences into a single scalar value.
Leverages a large-scale dataset of human similarity judgments annotated across multiple, free-form semantic aspects.

stories.title: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
stories.author: Lerrel Pinto
bullet_points: The paper addresses the underutilization of dense visual features from Vision Transformers (ViTs) in embodied robot control.
Current robot policies often either collapse observations into a single token or train visual backbones from scratch, losing fine-grained detail.
The proposed 'Patch Policy' aims to leverage dense patch features efficiently, addressing the computational overhead of existing dense-feature methods.

stories.title: Vector Search As Nearest Neighbor Matching: RAG-based Policy Learning in Causal Inference
stories.author: Taka Kato
bullet_points: Proposes novel one-step and two-step methods for policy learning utilizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Frames RAG-based action selection within the established potential outcome framework of causal inference.
The two-step method integrates vector search for retrieving neighboring evidence with a generator to estimate conditional outcomes.

stories.title: PPL-Factory: Task-Aware and Budget-Aware Data Selection from Language Modeling to Reasoning
stories.author: Warren J. Gross
bullet_points: Introduces PPL-Factory, a method for task-aware and budget-aware data selection during LLM fine-tuning.
Addresses the inefficiency of using all training samples by aiming to reduce computational cost while maintaining performance.
Overcomes limitations of existing methods that rely on fixed, task-independent heuristics (like data quality or diversity).

stories.title: Three-Body Scattering for Generative Modeling
stories.author: Tao Lin
bullet_points: Introduces Three-Body Scattering Modeling (TBSM) as an alternative to standard generative model architectures (e.g., GANs, autoregressive models).
Proposes using a proper distributional energy to induce sample-level motion and provide direct one-step regression supervision.
Frames the generation process as a constant-size per-projectile interaction based on energy distance.

stories.title: Certified Training for Convolutional Perturbations
stories.author: Alessio Lomuscio
bullet_points: Vision models are vulnerable to real-world perturbations, such as motion blur from camera shake.
Current robustness methods (e.g., data augmentation, Adversarial Training) lack formal safety guarantees.
The research proposes 'Certified Training' to provide formal safety guarantees against these perturbations.

stories.title: FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications
stories.author: Beidi Chen
bullet_points: FlashRT introduces an agent harness designed to guide the deployment of real-time multimodal applications.
These applications (like voice agents and interactive video) require complex pipeline management involving placement, streaming, and intra-model parallelism.
The system addresses limitations in existing serving systems that require manual, application-specific optimization for high performance.

stories.title: It's Not What You Say, It's How You Say It: Evaluating LLM Responses to Expressions of Belief
stories.author: Alex Warstadt
bullet_points: The research addresses how Large Language Models (LLMs) should handle user-expressed beliefs (EoBs).
It investigates that the linguistic form of an EoB (e.g., presuppositions, certainty markers) affects how the LLM processes it.
The study proposes a typology to systematically evaluate the persuasiveness and impact of different EoB styles on LLM behavior.

stories.title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
stories.author: Xiaodong Gu
bullet_points: Introduces SWE-Pruner Pro, an advancement in context pruning for coding LLMs.
The core finding is that the LLM agent itself possesses internal representations indicating code context relevance, rather than relying solely on external classifiers.
The new method prunes tool outputs directly within the agent using a small auxiliary head.

stories.title: PPL-Factory: Task-Aware and Budget-Aware Data Selection from Language Modeling to Reasoning
stories.author: Warren J. Gross
bullet_points: Introduces PPL-Factory, a method for task-aware and budget-aware data selection during LLM fine-tuning.
Addresses the inefficiency of using all training samples by aiming to reduce computational cost while maintaining performance.
Proposes moving beyond fixed, indirect heuristics (like quality or diversity) to a more task-dependent selection mechanism.

stories.title: VEHBench: A Stage-Local Diagnostic Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Vibration Energy Harvester Design
stories.author: Guobiao Hu
bullet_points: Introduces VEHBench, a new diagnostic benchmark specifically designed for LLM-assisted design of Vibration Energy Harvesters (VEHs).
Addresses a gap in current engineering benchmarks by focusing on LLM behavior across iterative, stage-local design processes under coupled physical constraints.
Connects the emerging role of LLMs as interface layers in engineering workflows to the practical challenges of battery-free IoT systems.

stories.title: Do Language Models Dream of Binding Molecules? Benchmarking LLMs under Spatial Constraints
stories.author: Alex Zhavoronkov
bullet_points: The research explores using Large Language Models (LLMs) for structure-based drug design (SBDD), a critical area in pharmaceutical research.
It addresses the current limitation of LLMs in reasoning about complex 3D spatial constraints, contrasting them with dominant diffusion models.
The work benchmarks LLMs' performance in generating molecules conditioned on specific protein pocket structures.

stories.title: O-VAD: Industrial Video Anomaly Detection through Object-Centric Tracking and Reasoning
stories.author: Min Xu
bullet_points: The research addresses Industrial Video Anomaly Detection (IVAD), a critical task for modern manufacturing quality control.
Existing Vision-Language Model (VLM) methods struggle with the specific complexities of industrial environments, such as intricate object transformations and physical constraints.
The proposed method, O-VAD, focuses on object-centric tracking and reasoning to improve anomaly detection accuracy in industrial settings.

stories.title: How Does Alignment Tuning Shape Representations of Sycophancy and Related Cue-Induced Biases in LLMs?
stories.author: Zhijing Jin
bullet_points: The research investigates how alignment tuning affects LLM representations of sycophancy and cue-induced biases.
It addresses the vulnerability of LLMs to subtle input changes, such as hints or incorrect few-shot examples.
The study extracts per-bias directions from hidden states across five model families and seven bias types.

stories.title: LLM-as-a-Coach: Experiential Learning for Non-Verifiable Tasks
stories.author: Furu Wei
bullet_points: Addresses a limitation in RL training where LLM-as-a-Judge reduces rich textual feedback to a single scalar reward.
Introduces 'Experiential Learning' (EL) to transform an LLM's assessment from a judge into a 'coach'.
The coach distills assessment into transferable experiential knowledge to condition and internalize learning within the policy model.

stories.title: Five US tech giants' hidden debts soar to $1.65T on opaque AI funding
stories.author: NordStreamYacht
bullet_points: Five major US tech giants are reportedly accumulating significant hidden debt.
The debt is linked to opaque funding mechanisms within the AI sector.
The total hidden debt figure mentioned reaches $1.65 trillion.

stories.title: Nativ: Run frontier open models locally on your Mac
stories.author: aratahikaru5
bullet_points: Nativ allows users to run frontier open-source AI models locally on macOS.
This addresses the growing desire for local, private AI inference on consumer hardware.
It represents a trend toward democratizing access to powerful LLMs outside of cloud APIs.

stories.title: 432 Linux kernel CVEs published in the last 24 hours
stories.author: lore.kernel.org via Helithumper
bullet_points: A large volume of 432 new CVEs related to the Linux kernel were published within a single 24-hour period.
This indicates a significant, rapid disclosure of security vulnerabilities in a foundational operating system.
The news is highly relevant to system administrators, cybersecurity professionals, and Linux users who must prioritize patching.

stories.title: AI And Code Ownership: Who Is Responsible For Generated Code?
stories.author: nazar-boyko
bullet_points: The article addresses the complex legal question of code ownership when AI generates software.
It highlights the ambiguity surrounding intellectual property rights for AI-assisted code.
This topic represents a growing, moderate industry discussion point in software development and law.
